title: 第一章 解气
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“顾淮！你他妈死了是不是？”

“现在都什么时辰了，还没起来？”

恍惚间，顾淮听到有人骂骂咧咧的在叫自己。

顾淮睁开双眼，环顾四周，映入眼帘的是发黑的土墙、身下肮脏破败的木板床，以及满屋子刺鼻的霉味。

嗯？！！

我得真皮大沙发大别墅呢？

这是哪儿？

就在这时，一股陌生的记忆窜入脑海之中，顾淮痛呼一声，好半天才适应了下来。

顾淮懵了。

他，竟然穿越了！

这是一个类似华夏古代封建王朝的地方，名为大楚王朝。

而自己，居然还是当朝礼部左侍郎顾延年的长子！

只是，这个身份并不光鲜。

原主是父亲及第前与青州老家的相好所生，但父亲高中后，便没有再回青州，而是娶了京城严太师之女，封妻荫子。

直到半月前，这才把他接到了京城。

原本原主以为，到了京城，终于能享福了。

可谁知！

他到了这里，并无人管他，甚至嫌他太脏，直接给丢进了马厩里，每天还给他安排许多重活儿！

几天前原主突感风寒，加之劳累过度，双管齐下，竟给病死了。

这才有了他的穿越。

“砰！”

这时，柴房木门被人一脚猛地踹开。

一个十七八岁的青年带着两个家丁冲了进来。

顾淮抬头看去，这人原主进顾府的时候见过，是他所谓的弟弟——顾钧！

刚一进门，顾钧就立刻捂住口鼻，满脸嫌恶地皱紧了眉头。

“真是臭气熏天，简直跟茅坑里的死老鼠一样脏。”

他扫视了一圈，看向从床上下来的顾淮，眼神里满是嫌弃和怒意。

“顾淮，昨天我是不是派人交代过你，今天必须早起？”

“父亲上朝前要跟你说事，你居然敢不去拜见，是不是不想活了？”

顾钧一边恶毒地辱骂，一边挽起昂贵的锦缎衣袖，大步上前就准备动手教训这个废物。

就在这时，一道瘦弱的身影急匆匆地从门外跑了进来。

一个十二三岁、穿着破烂的小丫头拦在顾淮的床前。

“二少爷息怒，您行行好。”

Page (1/3)

"Gu Huai! Are you fucking dead?"

"What time is it now? You haven't gotten up yet?"

In a daze, Gu Huai heard someone cursing and calling him.

Gu Huai opened his eyes and looked around. What he saw were the blackened earth walls, the dirty and dilapidated wooden bed beneath him, and the pungent musty smell that filled the room.

Um?!!

I want a big leather sofa and a big villa?

Where is this?

At this moment, a strange memory came into his mind. Gu Huai screamed in pain, and it took him a long time to get used to it.

Gu Huai was stunned.

He actually traveled through time!

This is a place similar to the ancient Chinese feudal dynasty, called the Chu Dynasty.

And he was actually the eldest son of Gu Yannian, the left minister of the Ministry of Rites!

However, this identity is not glamorous.

The original owner was the son of a good relationship between his father and his former family in Qingzhou. However, after his father was in high school, he did not return to Qingzhou. Instead, he married the daughter of Grand Master Yan from the capital and was given the title of Yinzi.

It wasn't until half a month ago that he was brought to the capital.

Originally, the original owner thought that after arriving in the capital, he would finally enjoy happiness.

But who knows!

When he got here, no one took care of him. He even thought he was too dirty and threw him directly into the stable. He was also assigned many heavy tasks every day!

A few days ago, the original owner suddenly caught a cold and was overworked. He died of the disease due to a combination of two-pronged measures.

This is how he traveled through time.

"Bang!"

At this time, the wooden door of the woodshed was kicked open violently.

A young man of seventeen or eighteen years old rushed in with two servants.

Gu Huai looked up and saw that the man the original owner had seen when he entered the Gu Mansion was his so-called younger brother - Gu Jun!

As soon as he entered the door, Gu Jun immediately covered his mouth and nose and frowned with disgust.

"It stinks to heaven, as dirty as a dead rat in a latrine."

He glanced around and looked at Gu Huai who got off the bed, his eyes full of disgust and anger.

"Gu Huai, did I send someone to tell you yesterday that you must get up early today?"

"My father wants to talk to you before going to court, but you dare not go to see him. Do you not want to live anymore?"

Gu Jun cursed viciously, rolled up his expensive brocade sleeves, and strode forward, ready to teach this loser a lesson.

At this moment, a thin figure hurriedly ran in from the door.

A little girl of twelve or thirteen years old, dressed in rags, stopped in front of Gu Huai's bed.

"Second Young Master, please calm down and do your best."
